items.title: CVE-2026-137416 | sgl-project SpecForge 0.2.0 Draft Embedding Loader base.py Eagle3DraftModel.load_embedding path traversal (Issue 1041)
items.summary: A vulnerability labeled as problematic has been found in sgl-project SpecForge 0.2.0 . This impacts the function Eagle3DraftModel.load_embedding of the file specforge/modeling/draft/base.py of the component Draft Embedding Loader . Executing a manipulation can lead to path traversal. The identification of this vulnerability is CVE-2026-137416 . The attack can only be executed locally. Furthermore, there is an exploit available. It is advisable to implement a patch to correct this issue.

If an administrator executes a privileged command from that directory, the malicious variables are loaded into the privileged process, resulting in local privilege escalation.

items.title: CVE-2026-136513
items.summary: When Debug or CommLog is enabled and the log directory cannot be used, psqlODBC falls back to a directory under the user's home directory. It wrote that path with an unexpanded , which is resolved relative to the process's current directory. Another local user who controls a directory on that path can make the driver create the victim's mylog.log and psqlodbc.log files in any directory the victim can write to, or leave the victim's process blocked in open. This completes the fix for CVE-2026-120066 in 18.00.0006. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected...

items.title: CVE-2026-138075
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in shopizer-ecommerce shopizer up to 3.2.5. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file sm-core/src/main/resources/authentication.properties. This manipulation causes use of hard-coded cryptographic key . It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

items.title: CVE-2026-138054
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file search.php. Such manipulation of the argument key leads to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-138301
items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in OgreBinarySerializer::ReadGeometryVertexBuffer that allows attackers to crash applications via crafted Ogre binary .mesh files. Attackers can supply a large vertex count that wraps the 32-bit size calculation, desynchronising parsing and causing aiScene teardown to delete uninitialised mesh pointers.

items.title: CVE-2026-138300
items.summary: CherryTree through 1.7.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application through uncaught std::stoi/std::stoll exceptions on malformed XML attributes. Attackers can craft a document with non-numeric or out-of-range char_offset, frame_width, frame_height, col_max, or time attributes to repeatedly crash CherryTree and block access to content.

items.title: CVE-2026-138299
items.summary: CherryTree through 1.7.3 contains a LaTeX rendering filter bypass vulnerability in _is_latex_text_safe() that allows attackers to read local files by building blocked command names with TeX macro expansion. Attackers can craft a document with a LaTeX node using \csname verbatiminput\endcsname to render user-readable files into the embedded note image when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-138295
items.summary: Net-SNMP snmpd through 5.9.5.2 and 5.10.pre1 before 5.10.pre3 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in view_parse_oid() that allows authenticated attackers with SNMP write access to corrupt heap memory. Attackers can send a single SET to vacmViewTreeFamilyTable whose index begins with sub-identifier 4294967295, causing a one-byte write before a malloc(0) allocation and crashing snmpd.

items.title: CVE-2026-138293
items.summary: emailjs 3.2.0 before 5.0.4 contains an address parsing vulnerability in addressparser that allows attackers to inject hidden recipients by abusing nested comments, semicolons, or backslash escapes. Attackers can craft recipient strings that pass conformant-parser allow lists but make emailjs send RCPT TO commands to attacker-chosen addresses, disclosing message content.

items.title: CVE-2026-138074
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in go-dev-frame sponge up to 1.16.1. The affected element is an unknown function of the file pkg/jwt/option.go of the component JWT. The manipulation results in use of hard-coded cryptographic key . The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project maintainer announces, that a separate auth certification center will be used to replace this old JWT package.

items.title: CVE-2026-138055
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in Cloud-CV EvalAI up to 30128ca50ab24a0c65e556d78199309e8ecc3eae. This affects an unknown function of the file settings/common.py of the component JWT Authentication. Performing a manipulation of the argument SECRET_KEY results in use of hard-coded cryptographic key . It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The patch is named 9c430a7c8675b1d4ae83925ec0da044c703d8441. It is suggested to install a patch to address this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-138056
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in SonicJs-Org SonicJS up to 3.0.1. This impacts the function AuthManager.verifyToken of the file packages/core/src/middleware/auth.ts. Executing a manipulation can lead to use of hard-coded cryptographic key . It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. A patch should be applied to remediate this issue. Vendor confirmed remediation by adding a bootstrap.ts security check that logs a warning in development and throws a hard error in production when JWT_SECRET is missing or still the default value.

items.title: CVE-2026-138262
items.summary: WinFsp before 2.2.26323 contains a kernel pool out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FspEaBufferFromFileSystemValidate that allows unprivileged local users to corrupt kernel memory via crafted extended-attribute responses. Attackers can mount a WinFsp file system and answer QueryEa or SetEa requests with malformed NextEntryOffset values, writing zero bytes past the pool allocation to crash the system.

items.title: CVE-2026-138256
items.summary: Apprise before 1.12.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NotifyEmail.send that ignores verify_certificate for SMTPS and STARTTLS connections. Network-positioned attackers can present self-signed or mismatched certificates to intercept SMTP AUTH credentials and notification contents, or modify and suppress notifications.

items.title: CVE-2026-138051
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in OpenAirInterface oai-cn5g-upf up to 2.2.2. This issue affects the function pfcp_user_id_ie::load_from of the file pfcp/3gpp_29.244.hpp of the component PFCP N4 User ID IE Type 141 Parser. The manipulation leads to heap-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-138053
items.summary: A flaw has been found in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /admin/manage_venue.php. This manipulation of the argument ID causes sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-138255
items.summary: ELADMIN through 2.7 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the user export endpoint that allows department-scoped users to export user records from other departments. Authenticated attackers holding user:list permission can request GET /api/users/download to obtain an XLSX containing usernames, roles, emails, and phone numbers across all departments.

items.title: CVE-2026-138052
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in OpenAirInterface oai-cn5g-amf up to 2.2.2. Impacted is the function amf_sbi::discover_smf of the file src/amf-app/amf_sbi.cpp of the component AMF. The manipulation results in denial of service. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The patch is identified as 1eabe18bf0cb5a248e0429f4daac91dee51c8a43. It is best practice to apply a patch to resolve this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-138050
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in OpenAirInterface oai-cn5g-udr up to 2.2.2. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file src/udr_app/database/mysql_db.cpp of the component Nudr_DR. Executing a manipulation of the argument ueId can lead to sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-138047
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in dcatadmin Dcat-Admin 2.2.2-beta. Affected by this issue is the function getDatabaseColumns of the file src/Http/Controllers/ScaffoldController.php. Such manipulation of the argument tb leads to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-138039
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in Open5GS up to 2.8.0. Affected is the function smf_ue_find_by_imsi of the file src/smf/context.c of the component SMF. The manipulation results in denial of service. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The patch is identified as df92296dbf60c21a2dd09e74f4903cee995cd2c2. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-138038
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in Open5GS 2.8.0. This impacts the function nrf_nnrf_handle_nf_discover of the file src/nrf/nnrf-handler.c of the component NRF. The manipulation leads to reachable assertion. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier of the patch is dbc35e6aadeb3f6ef3e028a8b52ee3cf5920082e. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-138036
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in Free5GC up to 4.3.0. The impacted element is the function PostPoliciesProcedure of the file internal/sbi/processor/ampolicy.go of the component PCF. Performing a manipulation of the argument supi results in incomplete cleanup. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The patch is named eba1c481300df4e7ac8000c99d0cc36dd73b941e. Applying a patch is the recommended action to fix this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-138005
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01. Affected by this vulnerability is the function gena.php::GENA_notify_init of the file htdocs/upnpinc/gena.php of the component UPnP Event Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument uri results in os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-138049
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in OpenAirInterface oai-cn5g-nrf up to 2.2.1. This affects the function notify_subscribed_event of the file src/nrf_app/nrf_client.cpp of the component NRF. Performing a manipulation results in null pointer dereference. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 2.2.2 is able to mitigate this issue. The patch is named 2065c6f80ca9ffdacc0064e768db90d04d9d6ca8. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-5771
items.summary: The Loco Translate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Write/Overwrite via Path Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.4. This is due to the normalize() function processing '..' segments in user-supplied paths without verifying that the resolved absolute path remains within the base directory. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Custom+ level access and above, to write translation files to arbitrary locations on the filesystem.

items.title: CVE-2026-138037
items.summary: A flaw has been found in Open5GS up to 2.8.0. This affects the function ogs_pfcp_handle_create_urr of the file lib/pfcp/handler.c of the component UPF PFCP N4. Executing a manipulation of the argument URR ID can lead to reachable assertion. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. This patch is called 08e0940e14ec41284e4270084694549de43dc219. It is best practice to apply a patch to resolve this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-138164
items.summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in SaveBackupText() in backtext.c that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory by supplying long text fields. Attackers can craft a backup with long calendar or note fields that, when converted with gammu convertbackup, writes hex digits past the 10,000-byte stack buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-138162
items.summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ALCATEL_EncodeString() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via oversized encoded phonebook text. Attackers can supply a crafted backup restored with gammu restore or addnew to an attached Alcatel phone, using GSM extension characters to crash Gammu or potentially execute code.

items.title: CVE-2026-138161
items.summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in LoadBackup() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying an overlong MD5 value in a crafted backup file. Attackers can overwrite adjacent phonebook and calendar entry pointers via strcpy() into MD5Original when files are loaded with convertbackup or restore, causing crashes or potential code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138160
items.summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ReadBackupTextLen() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted backup files. Attackers can supply overlong quoted text values decoded into a 10,000-byte stack array during convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile calls, causing crashes or potential code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138148
items.summary: picomatch through 4.0.7 contains a glob filter bypass vulnerability because globstar (**) patterns are compiled without the dotAll flag and fail to match line terminators. Attackers who control file, object key or archive entry names containing newline characters can evade ** deny patterns, causing excluded resources to be included and exposed.

items.title: CVE-2026-138163
items.summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted backup files with excess WAP or MMS settings entries. Attackers can supply a backup with more than four TitleNN keys in a [WAPSettings] or [MMSSettings] section, loaded via convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile, causing crashes or potential code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138158
items.summary: libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a stack buffer overflow in sierra_get_string_register() that lets a malicious sierra-protocol camera or USB device overwrite stack memory. When files are listed, the device can answer the file-name register with an oversized packet, writing up to 32 KB past small stack buffers to cause crashes or possible code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138154
items.summary: POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCommand with a start file URI. Attackers can ship a batch file in a mod at the predictable workshop install path and launch it via ShellExecuteW, executing commands as the player on Windows.

items.title: CVE-2026-123654
items.summary: Themify Base WordPress theme through 1.2.4 does not perform capability checks on its option save and read AJAX actions, which are protected only by a generic nonce that other commonly expose on the front end, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to update arbitrary blog options such as the default role and open registration, and gain administrator access when such a is active.

items.title: CVE-2026-112234
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not validate a user-supplied URL before requesting it server-side and storing the fetched response so that it can be read back, allowing users with Administrator privileges to perform Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks and read the responses of internal services.

items.title: CVE-2026-112232
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly sanitize and escape a popup shortcode attribute before it is reflected into a page and evaluated client-side, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to inject arbitrary JavaScript that executes in the session of any higher-privileged user, such as an administrator, who views the affected content.

items.title: CVE-2026-112231
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not sanitise or escape a custom styling value before storing it and printing it back into the pages a popup loads on, allowing users who are allowed to manage popups (an ability that can be delegated to lower-privileged roles) to inject JavaScript that executes in the browser of every visitor, including logged-in administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-138153
items.summary: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Posts Grid block and Atomic Wind query loop that allows Contributor-level attackers to read non-public post type entries. Attackers can set the postTypes or queryPostType block attributes to types like flamingo_inbound or shop_coupon to expose titles and text, while the Atomic Wind custom_field path also leaks protected post meta.

items.title: CVE-2026-138152
items.summary: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Contributor-level attackers to make the server contact arbitrary hosts via crafted Mailchimp API keys. Attackers can POST to the otter/v1/form/editor REST route with an apiKey whose data-center segment embeds a host, following redirects to internal services and reading partial responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-138151
items.summary: bgpq4 before 1.17 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in expander.c that allows malicious IRR servers to corrupt heap memory by sending crafted A replies. Attackers controlling the IRR server or tampering with the plaintext TCP connection can announce a ULONG_MAX or -1 length, wrapping the allocation to one byte and crashing bgpq4.

items.title: CVE-2026-138150
items.summary: SimGear through 2024.1.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in sgSimpleBuffer::resize() where an unsigned 32-bit wraparound in the size-doubling loop leaves the size at zero. Attackers can supply a crafted .btg scenery file with an oversized byte count exceeding 2^31 to hang the loading process in FlightGear.

items.title: CVE-2026-138149
items.summary: FeatBit before 6.1.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated members of one organization to read other organizations' segments by supplying foreign segment identifiers. Attackers can query the SegmentController segment, by-ids, and flag-references endpoints with their own envId to retrieve end-user keys, targeting rules, and referencing feature flag keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-138122
items.summary: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated course members to access other tenants' newsfeed posts by supplying a foreign feedId under their own courseId. Attackers can read, react to, and comment on cross-organization posts, while team members or org admins can also overwrite content, pin flags, and delete them.

items.title: CVE-2026-138121
items.summary: Kestra 1.3.24 before 1.3.41 contains an insufficient credential expiration vulnerability that allows holders of a revoked administrator password to keep authenticating on peer webserver nodes through BasicAuthService's process-local verified-token cache. Attackers whose token remains cached on a peer node can call POST /api/v1/{tenant}/basicAuth to overwrite the shared administrator credentials and lock out the legitimate administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-138118
items.summary: HyperSpy from 1.4.0 before 2.6.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code by supplying crafted stored-model data in .hspy or .zspy files. Attackers can embed a malicious pickle payload in a component's _class_dump or a 'fn'-flagged _whitelist entry, which cloudpickle.loads() (dill in 1.x) runs when the victim restores the model.

items.title: CVE-2026-138117
items.summary: HyperSpy from 1.2.0 before 2.6.0 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run Python code by embedding malicious expression strings evaluated with sympy.sympify(). Attackers can craft .hspy or .zspy files with malicious axis, Expression component, or twin function expressions that execute when victims call hs.load() or restore models.

items.title: CVE-2026-107951
items.summary: Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration in the BigFix MCM WebUI allowed the data: URI scheme as a source in the img-src directive of the CSP header. This potentially weakens the application's defense-in-depth security mechanism.

items.title: CVE-2026-138004
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR and TEW-733GR 1.03B01. Affected is the function soapcgi_main of the file /soap.cgi of the component UPnP Igd Control Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument service leads to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-138159
items.summary: edbrowse through 3.8.19 contains an integer overflow in stringAndBytes() that allows malicious servers to write past a heap buffer by sending response bodies larger than 2 GB. When a user browses to an attacker-controlled HTTP, FTP, or gopher server, the oversized body skips reallocation and corrupts the heap, causing crashes or potentially code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138003
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01. This impacts the function FUN_0040ed90 of the file wfadev.cgi of the component UPnP/WFA. This manipulation of the argument SOAPAction causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. A high degree of complexity is needed for the attack. The exploitability is said to be difficult. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-136113
